task.description: The task that this workflow made or filled in, for example "(Task) 750 Invocation Readiness". Set it after Stage 1, with the title after the rename. Set it again after a later rename.

next.interactive: Create the task in todo, rename it, and give it to the person. Then set the output: flint shard invocations set-output {{invocation}} task='(Task) NNN Title'.
next.headless: Rewrite the stub task of the Plate in place into a complete spec, or create the task when there is no stub. Keep it in todo, and rename it. Then set the output: flint shard invocations set-output {{invocation}} task='(Task) NNN Title'.

next.interactive: Refine the spec of {{output.task}} with the person until the person confirms it.
next.headless: Check the spec of {{output.task}} yourself: it must read as a complete, actionable task. When the scope is not clear, use a deferred request.

next.interactive: Set the priority and the due date when the person gave them, and update the increment log when from names an increment. Then close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done.
next.headless: Write the Task Log entry of the spec, and close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Put the do_task command of the close in the result, and return with flint orbh session return --finish.
